description: This file contains a comprehensive set of Playwright test specifications focused on testing the tracing feature, including scenarios for starting, stopping, capturing, and analyzing traces. It also tests various configurations and behaviors related to traces such as attachments, source saving, nested steps, error handling, and fixture management.

methods.name: should stop tracing with trace: on-first-retry, when not retrying
methods.description: Tests that tracing stops correctly when configured with 'on-first-retry' and the retry count is at specific points.

methods.name: should record api trace
methods.description: Verifies that API-related traces are correctly recorded when trace is enabled, including nested actions.

methods.name: should not throw with trace: on-first-retry and two retries in the same worker
methods.description: Ensures stability when multiple retries are involved with 'on-first-retry' tracing mode.

methods.name: should not mixup network files between contexts
methods.description: Checks that network resources are correctly attributed to their respective contexts in traces to avoid mix-ups.

methods.name: should save sources when requested
methods.description: Verifies that source code is included in the trace resources when configured to do so.

methods.name: should not save sources when not requested
methods.description: Verifies that source code is not included in the trace resources when disabled.

methods.name: should work in serial mode
methods.description: Tests that tracing functions correctly in serial test execution mode.

methods.name: should not override trace file in afterAll
methods.description: Ensures that traces are preserved correctly even when multiple tests modify or generate traces in hooks.

methods.name: should not throw when attachment is missing
methods.description: Checks robustness when an attachment is referenced but missing.

methods.name: should record trace for manually created context in a failed test
methods.description: Tests trace recording when a manual browser context is created within a test that fails.

methods.name: should expand expect.toPass
methods.description: Verifies that complex assertions with expect.toPass are traced accurately.

methods.name: should show non-expect error in trace
methods.description: Checks that errors not related to expect are displayed correctly in the trace.

methods.name: should show error from beforeAll in trace
methods.description: Verifies that errors thrown in beforeAll hooks are captured in the trace.

methods.name: should throw when trace fixture is a function
methods.description: Ensures proper error handling when the trace configuration is improperly set as a function.

methods.name: should not throw when attachment is missing
methods.description: Redundant with an earlier test, also ensures robustness against missing attachments.

methods.name: should use custom expect message in trace
methods.description: Checks that custom messages in expect assertions are correctly reflected in traces.

methods.name: should not throw when merging traces multiple times
methods.description: Verifies that multiple merging operations on traces are handled gracefully.

methods.name: should record nested steps, even after timeout
methods.description: Tests that nested steps within tests are recorded properly, even when timeouts occur.

methods.name: should not produce an action entry for calling a binding
methods.description: Ensures that calling a page binding does not produce an unnecessary trace action entry.

methods.name: should attribute worker fixture teardown to the right test
methods.description: Checks correct attribution of fixture teardown actions to respective tests.

methods.name: trace:retain-on-first-failure should create trace but only on first failure
methods.description: Verifies that traces are only created for the first failure under 'retain-on-first-failure' mode.

methods.name: trace:retain-on-first-failure should create trace if context is closed before failure in the test
methods.description: Ensures that a trace is recorded when the context is closed before a failure occurs.

methods.name: trace:retain-on-first-failure should create trace if context is closed before failure in afterEach
methods.description: Verifies trace creation in afterEach hooks when the context is closed before failure.

methods.name: trace:retain-on-first-failure should create trace if request context is disposed before failure
methods.description: Checks trace recording when a request context is disposed prior to failure.

methods.name: should include attachments by default
methods.description: Verifies that attachments are included in traces unless explicitly disabled.

methods.name: should opt out of attachments
methods.description: Tests that trace configuration disables attachments correctly.

methods.name: should record with custom page fixture
methods.description: Verifies tracing with a custom page fixture that extends base functionality.

methods.name: should expand expect.toPass
methods.description: Similar to previous, focusing on nested expect assertions in traces.

methods.name: should show non-expect error in trace
methods.description: Checks that unexpected errors are visible in traces.

methods.name: should show error from beforeAll in trace
methods.description: Captures errors thrown during beforeAll hooks within the trace.

methods.name: should throw when trace fixture is a function
methods.description: Tests validation rules for the trace fixture configuration.

methods.name: should not throw when attachment is missing
methods.description: Ensures robustness against missing attachments.

methods.name: should use custom expect message in trace
methods.description: Checks trace reflection of custom expect messages.

methods.name: should not throw when merging traces multiple times
methods.description: Verifies stability when merging traces repeatedly.

methods.name: should record nested steps, even after timeout
methods.description: Tests correctness of nested step recording with timeouts.

methods.name: should not produce an action entry for calling a binding
methods.description: Ensures no extraneous actions are logged for bindings.

methods.name: should attribute worker fixture teardown to the right test
methods.description: Verifies correct attribution of fixture teardown.

methods.name: trace:retain-on-first-failure should create trace if context is closed before failure in the test

methods.name: trace:retain-on-first-failure should create trace if request is disposed before failure
